description: Create an Airflow DAG for health_portal that delivers the daily bed-occupancy extract to a government endpoint with a hard 08:00 Europe/Paris deadline, with staged escalation. The DAG starts at 05:00 local time and should: (1) build the extract, (2) validate it, (3) submit it, (4) in parallel run a 'deadline_watch' branch made of DateTimeSensorAsync tasks at 07:00, 07:30 and 07:50 local time, each followed by a task that checks whether 'submit' has succeeded for this run and, if not, escalates (07:00 Slack, 07:30 page primary, 07:50 page manager and submit the last validated extract flagged as provisional).
edge_cases: The census date is the previous local calendar day; the run starting at 05:00 on day D reports day D-1, which equals the data interval start date only when the DAG timezone is local
Escalation checks must look at the state of 'submit' in the same DAG run and must not be skipped when upstream tasks fail
The watch branch must not depend on the main branch; otherwise a build failure marks the watch tasks upstream_failed
If the main submit succeeds after a provisional submission, a corrected final submission must be sent
DST: 08:00 Paris time is 06:00 or 07:00 UTC depending on the season
common_failure_modes: FM6: Watch tasks placed downstream of submit never run when submit fails or hangs
FM2: Deadlines hard-coded in UTC shift by one hour for half the year
FM7: Provisional fallback submitted without a flag, indistinguishable from validated data
